kcc_query_text_example: SC marginal dryland farmer with 1.5 acres rainfed ragi in H.D. Kote, Mysuru; dependent entirely on erratic rainfall; applying for Krishi Honda (farm pond) with polythene lining and diesel pump package under Krishi Bhagya; seeking subsidy percentage and RSK application procedure.

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: Zero electrical infrastructure on rainfed dryland parcel

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in H.D. Kote taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Watershed Development Department: Rainfed red soil tract in H.D. Kote/Periyapatna taluks, Mysuru district, designated notified dryland zone qualifying for Krishi Bhagya in situ rainwater harvesting.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka Krishi Bhagya query logs: Marginal dryland SC farmers asking about farm pond excavation subsidies in Southern Dry Zone.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Evaluates Krishi Bhagya on SC marginal dryland parcel (1.5 ac); Mysuru is a notified rainfed district; dryland kushki verified; qualifies in Section A (KRISHI_BHAGYA_DRYLAND_VERIFIED, KRISHI_BHAGYA_DISTRICT_NOTIFIED, KRISHI_BHAGYA_ACREAGE_VALID), noting historical 90% SC rate is pending FY 2026-27 GO verification; PM-KISAN qualifies in Section A; Ambedkar Ganga Kalyana raw engine returns ELIGIBLE (GK_AMBEDKAR_INDIVIDUAL_ROUTE_VALID) on demographic land interval [1.5, 5.0] ac and recorded family income of ₹1.10 Lakh (H.D. Kote rural classification). CRITICAL GOVERNANCE SAFEGUARD: In alignment with S029 governance precedent, official Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Development Corporation guidelines require both land parcel adjacency to a perennial water source (rivers/streams/tanks) and administrative confirmation of the applicable district annual family income ceiling (historical ₹1.50 Lakh rural ceiling vs ₹2.00 Lakh state ceiling order). Because S045 lacks recorded perennial source adjacency and Mysuru rural income ceiling rules remain unverified against a current scheme-specific Government Order, governance strictly decouples SCH010_AMBEDKAR to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION without numerical scoring; abstract parent SCH010 is suppressed; PMFBY routed to Section B pending seasonal IU notification.

intended_test_purpose: Validate Krishi Bhagya farm pond eligibility on SC marginal dryland holding matching primary need; enforce Ambedkar Ganga Kalyana source-adjacency and income-rule governance safeguards; confirm parent suppression.
